description: Versions of everything Mozg runs on, tested as three presets rather than as the product of every version. oldest: the oldest release line each project still supports. lts: its current long-term-support line, or its newest stable release where it has no LTS. newest: its newest release, pre-releases included (allowed to fail: an early warning, not a gate). scripts/ci-presets.js checks the presets against endoflife.date every week (.github/workflows/presets-drift.yml). Checked on 2026-11-06.

pins.mysql: Mozg's mysql connector reaches MySQL 8.4 at most: 9.x removed mysql_native_password, the only login its client speaks (docs/connectors.md, finding 2).
pins.arangodb: 3.12 is ArangoDB's only supported line, and it publishes no current pre-release images.
pins.nodeImageTag: Node nightlies are not published as container images, so the newest image is the newest released line.
